revisions.headline: Leaf collection begins Monday 2 November
revisions.body: City crews will collect bagged leaves from the kerb on each street's regular waste day from Monday 2 November until Friday 11 December. Use paper bags; plastic bags will not be taken.

revisions.headline: Hydrant flushing in Old Quay this week
revisions.body: Crews will flush hydrants in Old Quay between 09:00 and 15:00 from Monday 26 October to Friday 30 October. Tap water may look cloudy for a short time; run the cold tap until it clears.

revisions.headline: Ferry Hill bakery reopens after kitchen fire
revisions.body: Storvik's Bakery on Ferry Hill Road reopened on Monday, five weeks after a kitchen fire closed it. The owner said the ovens have been replaced and all eight staff are back.

revisions.headline: Leaf collection starts 2 November
revisions.body: The city will collect bagged leaves from the kerb on regular waste days from Monday 2 November to Friday 11 December. Paper bags only.

revisions.headline: Storvik's Bakery is open again
revisions.body: Storvik's Bakery on Ferry Hill Road is open again after the fire in September, with new ovens and the same staff.

revisions.headline: Canal Street resurfacing starts Wednesday
revisions.body: Public Works will resurface Canal Street between the harbour gate and Quay Road from Wednesday 28 October. The work is expected to take five working days. One lane stays open throughout.

revisions.headline: Canal Street resurfacing extended to Thursday 5 November
revisions.body: Rain has delayed the resurfacing of Canal Street. Public Works now expects to finish on Thursday 5 November. One lane stays open throughout.

revisions.headline: Harbour wall repairs enter second phase
revisions.body: Contractors began the second phase of repairs to the Quayside harbour wall on Tuesday. The footpath along the wall is closed between the fish market and the ferry steps until the end of November.

revisions.headline: Harbour wall footpath to reopen a week early
revisions.body: The footpath along the Quayside harbour wall is now expected to reopen on Monday 23 November, a week earlier than planned, the contractor said.

revisions.headline: Public hearing on the Old Quay parking plan
revisions.body: The council will hear residents on the Old Quay parking plan on Thursday 5 November at 18:30 in Room 2 of the Old Quay Community Centre. Written comments are accepted until Wednesday 4 November.

revisions.note: An earlier version gave the wrong room. The hearing is in the Main Hall, not Room 2.
revisions.headline: Public hearing on the Old Quay parking plan
revisions.body: The council will hear residents on the Old Quay parking plan on Thursday 5 November at 18:30 in the Main Hall of the Old Quay Community Centre. Written comments are accepted until Wednesday 4 November.

revisions.headline: Hearing on Old Quay parking: 5 November
revisions.body: Residents can speak on the Old Quay parking plan on Thursday 5 November at 18:30, Room 2, Old Quay Community Centre. Written comments close on 4 November.

revisions.headline: School board weighs later start times
revisions.body: The Halden school board is considering starting secondary schools at 08:45 instead of 08:00 from next autumn. A vote is expected in December.

revisions.headline: School board weighs later start times; parent survey opens
revisions.body: The Halden school board is considering starting secondary schools at 08:45 instead of 08:00 from next autumn. A survey for parents is open until 20 November. A vote is expected in December.

revisions.note: An earlier version said the board would vote in December. The vote is scheduled for 14 January.
revisions.headline: School board weighs later start times; parent survey opens
revisions.body: The Halden school board is considering starting secondary schools at 08:45 instead of 08:00 from next autumn. A survey for parents is open until 20 November. The board is scheduled to vote on 14 January.

revisions.headline: Old Quay parking plan goes to a public hearing
revisions.body: Residents can speak on the council's Old Quay parking plan at a hearing on Thursday 5 November at 18:30 at the Old Quay Community Centre. The plan would add permit zones on six streets.

revisions.headline: Ferry Hill robotics team wins regional round
revisions.body: A team of six pupils from Ferry Hill Secondary won the regional robotics round on Wednesday and goes on to the state final in January.

revisions.headline: Winter gritting routes published
revisions.body: Public Works has published this winter's gritting routes. Main roads and bus routes are treated first; side streets follow when frost is forecast for more than one night.

revisions.headline: Old Quay Library adds Sunday story hour
revisions.body: Old Quay Library will hold a story hour for under-fives every Sunday at 11:00, starting on 8 November. No booking is needed.

revisions.note: An earlier version gave the wrong time. Story hour starts at 10:00, not 11:00.
revisions.headline: Old Quay Library adds Sunday story hour
revisions.body: Old Quay Library will hold a story hour for under-fives every Sunday at 10:00, starting on 8 November. No booking is needed.

revisions.headline: Sunday story hour at Old Quay Library
revisions.body: Under-fives are welcome at a new Sunday story hour at Old Quay Library, 11:00 every week from 8 November.

revisions.note: This post repeated a start time that the Old Quay Ledger has since corrected. See the Ledger's article for the right time.

revisions.headline: Quayside ferry to cut Sunday sailings
revisions.body: The Quayside ferry will run every 40 minutes on Sundays from 15 November, down from every 20 minutes, the operator said.

revisions.note: An earlier version said Sunday sailings would run every 40 minutes. The operator's timetable shows every 30 minutes.
revisions.headline: Quayside ferry to cut Sunday sailings
revisions.body: The Quayside ferry will run every 30 minutes on Sundays from 15 November, down from every 20 minutes, the operator said.

revisions.headline: Fewer Sunday ferries from 15 November
revisions.body: From 15 November the Quayside ferry runs every 40 minutes on Sundays instead of every 20.

revisions.headline: Meter replacement programme reaches Upper Ferry Hill
revisions.body: Crews will replace water meters in Upper Ferry Hill from Monday 9 November. Each household gets a card two days before its visit. Water is off for about 30 minutes.

revisions.headline: Meter replacement in Upper Ferry Hill starts Tuesday 10 November
revisions.body: The start of meter replacement in Upper Ferry Hill has moved by one day to Tuesday 10 November. Each household gets a card two days before its visit. Water is off for about 30 minutes.

revisions.headline: Quayside fishmonger to close after 40 years
revisions.body: Harrow & Daughter, the fishmonger on Canal Street, will close this winter after 40 years, its owner told the Ledger. No closing day has been set.

revisions.headline: Quayside fishmonger sets its closing day: 28 November
revisions.body: Harrow & Daughter, the fishmonger on Canal Street, will close on Saturday 28 November after 40 years, its owner told the Ledger.

revisions.headline: Council candidate withdraws from Ferry Hill race
revisions.body: One of the three candidates for the Ferry Hill council seat has withdrawn, according to a filing with the city clerk.

revisions.note: This report was published in error. No candidate has withdrawn; the Courier confused two filings.

revisions.headline: Halden outdoor rink opens 28 November
revisions.body: The outdoor rink in Halden Common opens for the season on Saturday 28 November. Skating is free; skate hire costs 4 dollars.

revisions.headline: Outdoor rink opening moved to 5 December
revisions.body: The opening of the outdoor rink in Halden Common has moved to Saturday 5 December because the chiller was delivered late. Skating is free; skate hire costs 4 dollars.

revisions.headline: Council approves winter shelter funding
revisions.body: The council has approved funding for 40 extra shelter beds from 1 December to 31 March. The beds will be at the Old Quay mission and the Millbrook church hall.

revisions.headline: Flood siren test planned for Quayside
revisions.body: The harbour authority plans to test the Quayside flood siren on Saturday 7 November at noon, the Ledger understands.

revisions.note: No siren test is planned. This report relied on an out-of-date schedule and has been withdrawn.

revisions.headline: Bus drivers and city reach pay agreement
revisions.body: The city and the bus drivers' union reached a tentative pay agreement on Thursday, ending the threat of a strike. Drivers vote on it on Friday.

revisions.headline: Bus drivers vote to accept pay agreement
revisions.body: Bus drivers voted on Friday to accept the pay agreement reached with the city on Thursday. Services run as normal.

revisions.headline: This week in Halden: five things to know
revisions.body: Leaf collection is under way, the bus strike is off, the Old Quay parking hearing drew a full hall, the fishmonger on Canal Street has set its last day, and the rink opens on 28 November.

revisions.headline: Millbrook North street party set for 21 November
revisions.body: Neighbours on Tanner Street are holding a street party on Saturday 21 November from 14:00. Bring a dish; the street is closed to cars from noon.

revisions.headline: Old Quay school fair raises funds for music room
revisions.body: Saturday's fair at Old Quay Primary raised enough to refit the school's music room, the parents' association said.

revisions.headline: Flu vaccination clinics at community centres
revisions.body: Free flu vaccinations are offered at the Millbrook and Old Quay community centres on Saturday 14 November from 09:00 to 13:00. No appointment is needed.

revisions.headline: Flu vaccination clinics at three community centres
revisions.body: Free flu vaccinations are offered at the Millbrook, Old Quay and Ferry Hill community centres on Saturday 14 November from 09:00 to 13:00. No appointment is needed.

revisions.headline: Boil-water notice for Millbrook
revisions.body: A pressure loss at the Millbrook pumping station may have let untreated water into the mains. Until further notice, boil tap water for one minute before drinking or cooking anywhere in Millbrook.

revisions.note: An earlier version covered all of Millbrook. The notice applies only to Millbrook South. Millbrook North is supplied from the Tanner Street reservoir and is not affected.
revisions.headline: Boil-water notice for Millbrook South
revisions.body: A pressure loss at the Millbrook pumping station may have let untreated water into the mains. Until further notice, boil tap water for one minute before drinking or cooking in Millbrook South. Millbrook North is not affected.

revisions.headline: Boil-water notice lifted for Millbrook South
revisions.body: Two rounds of tests show that the water in Millbrook South is safe. The boil-water notice ended on Friday 13 November at 10:00. Run the cold tap for two minutes before first use.

revisions.headline: Boil your tap water in Millbrook
revisions.body: Halden Public Works says to boil tap water for one minute before drinking or cooking anywhere in Millbrook, until further notice.

revisions.headline: Millbrook residents told to boil tap water
revisions.body: Households across Millbrook have been told to boil tap water after a pressure loss at the pumping station. Public Works could not say how long the notice will last.

revisions.headline: Boil-water notice narrowed to Millbrook South
revisions.body: Public Works has narrowed its boil-water notice to Millbrook South. Households in Millbrook North no longer need to boil tap water, the department said on Wednesday.

revisions.headline: Farmers' market moves indoors for winter
revisions.body: The Old Quay farmers' market moves into the fish market hall from Saturday 14 November and stays there until March.

revisions.headline: Boil your water, Millbrook
revisions.body: Reminder from Public Works: boil tap water for one minute before drinking or cooking anywhere in Millbrook, until further notice.

revisions.headline: Emergency water main repair on Tanner Street tonight
revisions.body: A burst main on Tanner Street is being repaired overnight. Homes in Millbrook North may have low pressure or no water between 23:00 and 05:00.

revisions.headline: Power restored after Tuesday outage in Old Quay
revisions.body: Power was restored to about 300 homes in Old Quay late on Tuesday after a transformer fault, the utility said.

revisions.headline: Overnight lane closure on Ferry Hill Road
revisions.body: One lane of Ferry Hill Road will be closed between 21:00 and 05:00 from Saturday 14 November to Monday 16 November for drain repairs. Expect delays near the junction with Kestrel Bridge.

revisions.note: An earlier version named the wrong road. The lane closure is on Quay Road in Old Quay, not Ferry Hill Road.
revisions.headline: Overnight lane closure on Quay Road
revisions.body: One lane of Quay Road will be closed between 21:00 and 05:00 from Saturday 14 November to Monday 16 November for drain repairs. Ferry Hill Road is not affected.

revisions.headline: Overnight closure planned for Ferry Hill Road
revisions.body: Drivers should expect overnight delays on Ferry Hill Road this weekend, when one lane closes for drain repairs, Public Works said.

revisions.headline: School bus route 7: stop change from Monday
revisions.body: From Monday 16 November, school bus route 7 no longer stops at Tanner Street. Pupils board at the Millbrook North community centre instead, five minutes earlier, at 07:20. All other stops are unchanged.

revisions.headline: School bus route 7: Tanner Street stop stays until 27 November
revisions.body: The Tanner Street stop on school bus route 7 stays in use until Friday 27 November, while the footpath to the community centre is finished. From Monday 30 November pupils board at the Millbrook North community centre at 07:20. All other stops are unchanged.

revisions.headline: Route 7 school bus drops Tanner Street from Monday
revisions.body: From Monday 16 November, pupils on school bus route 7 board at the Millbrook North community centre at 07:20 instead of Tanner Street.

revisions.headline: Route 7 school bus to skip Tanner Street
revisions.body: The city is moving a stop on school bus route 7 from Tanner Street to the Millbrook North community centre from Monday. Parents on Tanner Street said they were told on Friday.

revisions.headline: Saturday market: who is trading this week
revisions.body: Twenty-two stalls trade in the fish market hall this Saturday from 08:00 to 13:00, among them the cheese stall, which returns after a month away.

revisions.headline: Quay Road down to one lane overnight this weekend
revisions.body: One lane of Quay Road closes between 21:00 and 05:00 from Saturday to Monday for drain repairs. Public Works first announced the closure for Ferry Hill Road and corrected it on Friday.

revisions.headline: Riverside Clinic to close in December, board papers show
revisions.body: Riverside Clinic in Millbrook South will close on 18 December and move its patients to the Northgate clinic, according to board papers seen by the Courier.

revisions.headline: Kestrel Bridge closed for deck repairs from Thursday
revisions.body: Kestrel Bridge will be closed to all traffic from Thursday 19 November at 07:00 until Saturday 21 November at 18:00. Use the Ferry Hill crossing.

revisions.note: An earlier version gave the wrong start day. The closure begins on Wednesday 18 November at 07:00, not Thursday 19 November.
revisions.headline: Kestrel Bridge closed for deck repairs from Wednesday
revisions.body: Kestrel Bridge will be closed to all traffic from Wednesday 18 November at 07:00 until Saturday 21 November at 18:00. Use the Ferry Hill crossing.

revisions.headline: Old Quay Library open until 21:00 on weekdays
revisions.body: From Tuesday 17 November, Old Quay Library is open until 21:00 from Monday to Friday. Weekend hours are unchanged.

revisions.note: An earlier version gave the wrong closing time. On weekdays the library closes at 19:00, not 21:00.
revisions.headline: Old Quay Library open until 19:00 on weekdays
revisions.body: From Tuesday 17 November, Old Quay Library is open until 19:00 from Monday to Friday, one hour later than before. Weekend hours are unchanged.

revisions.headline: Old Quay Library to open until 21:00 on weekdays
revisions.body: From Tuesday 17 November, Old Quay Library stays open until 21:00 from Monday to Friday, the city says.

revisions.headline: Old Quay Library to stay open later on weekdays
revisions.body: Old Quay Library will stay open until 21:00 on weekdays from Tuesday, the city announced on Monday evening. Librarians said the extra hours are staffed by two new part-time posts.

revisions.headline: Later evenings at Old Quay Library
revisions.body: Good news for night owls: from Tuesday 17 November, Old Quay Library is open until 21:00 on weekdays.

Corrected: Millbrook South only. Dad still has to boil.

clippings.note: Cheese stall is back. Go before 11.
Asked Riverside to move Mum's 3 December appointment to Northgate.
Study group on Tuesday, 19:30 at Old Quay Library.
